info.author: Mahdi Ghasemi
info.name: abarorm
info.summary: abarorm is a lightweight and easy-to-use Object-Relational Mapping (ORM) library for SQLite & PostgreSQL and MySQL databases in Python. It aims to provide a simple and intuitive interface for managing database models and interactions.
